title: 30ft Double Decker Triple Slide Party Boat with Captain up to 22
blurb:
1 TRAVELER RESERVES THE WHOLE BOAT FOR YOUR PARTY OF UP TO 22 PASSENGERS.

This is the only triple slide boat with a capacity of 22 on the entire lake. 
We are the only party boat charter company that offers Master Captains whom have been here their whole lives and know Nashville better than any other tour guide. We offer not only a party atmosphere complete with BYOB options, coolers, ice, music, and various floatables, but we are also family friendly as well. Enjoy water sports with your friends or chill on party cove amongst other party goers. There are many places to relax on the lake as well.
